mapper.select: SELECT TRAIN_SEQ, TRAIN_TYPE, TRAIN_RES, TO_CHAR(TRAIN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAIN_DT FROM TRAIN WHERE PHONE_NUM=#{phoneNum} ORDER BY TRAIN_SEQ
SELECT TRAIN_RES FROM TRAIN WHERE PHONE_NUM=#{phoneNum} AND TRAIN_SEQ=(SELECT MAX(A.TRAIN_SEQ) FROM TRAIN A WHERE A.PHONE_NUM=#{phoneNum})
